## Verdict
REVISE — Freeze the selection contract and ensure longer-window comparisons use genuinely matched contacts.

## Critical gaps
- “Coverage first” leaves case/copy weighting, final ties, and held-out winner qualification unspecified. Explicitly forbid promotion from unequal surviving cohorts when rows are incomplete.

## Important improvements
- `community_contacts.py:152` makes restart timing—and subsequent RNG consumption—depend on horizon. Generate one maximal trace and truncate it for common-window comparisons. Also predeclare the common lifetime: the default 3,600-second TTL limits what longer windows can demonstrate.

## Validation gaps
- Selection fixtures covering missing/duplicate rows, budget failures, exact ties, and unequal denominators.
- Verify contact/restart prefix equality across window lengths and identical workloads across matched policies; distinguish expiry from window censoring.

## Recommended revision
1. Freeze aggregation, eligibility, tie-breaking, qualification, and complete evaluation manifests.
2. Construct prefix-matched window cases with explicit lifetime semantics.
3. Add the checks above, then retain the planned implementation, staged sweeps, and canonical validation sequence.

## Acceptance Contract
Acceptance level: attested
